When a female anthro or demi-human is ready to breed they go into a hypersensitive state. This state is called being in heat. The stage of heat, also called estrus or season, has distinct physical and behavioral signs. 

When in heat a couple of things can happen, depending on the species of said anthro or demi-human. The vulva becomes large, red, or swollen, paring with some bleeding or blood-tinted discharge. This heat can increase the anthro's or demi-human's hormonal need for pregnancy, causing them to turn over to their hormonal side. This can induce the behavior of mounting, humping, exposing themself, nervousness, and more. The heat increases their fertility therefore increasing the chance of becoming pregnant.

This heat produces a scent that can attract other anthros and demi-humans, Humies are the only ones that cannot pick up on this smell but can observe the signs of an ongoing heat. Some anthros or demi-humans can become more aggressive or submissive depending on their need.

entries.name: Flared Penis
entries.content:
A flared penis is a penis, usually equine, with a distinctly swollen glans (a flare.) This corresponds with the Equine (Horse) family, An actual Equine penis must flare before it can ejaculate, but may visibly flare at any point in its arousal.

The biological purpose is to "seal" the glans against the cervix so that ejaculation directly enters the uterus.

Flaring is also known as belling.

entries.name: Ovipositor
entries.content: A hole possessed by certain female insects, which is generally located at the tip of the abdomen and used exclusively to lay eggs. Among parasitic species, it may be extruded into a piercing organ, used to lay eggs inside prey. Typically, these are used for depositing eggs, parasites, etc. but can be used for pleasure and stimulation.

entries.name: Oviposition
entries.content: Oviposition is the process of laying eggs, oviposition describes eggs exiting a body into an external environment, usually from an orifice. An oviposition may suggest that a body will lay one or a few eggs, or perhaps that a single body will lay a clutch of tens or even hundreds of eggs.

entries.name: Demi-Human Slaves
entries.content:
Slavery is mainly for the Demi-humans. Humies see them as a lesser race, due to this they capture and seek out Demis in order to put them into slavery. Although Anthros have a problem with this and can't do anything about it, Humies threatened the ambassador of the Anthros that they'd be next if they started something. Causing the Anthros to turn a blind eye to the cruelty towards the Demi-humans.

Marin CO. is the leading company for buying and selling slaved Demi-humans. Demis are caught, processed, collared, and then are ready to be sold as a slave. Marin Co. has bounty hunters and authorities on hand to capture any stray Demi-humans, so it is advised that most Demi-humans stay in the shadows to avoid being caught.

Humies prance around with collared Demi-humans like trophies. The Humies Law requires the captured Demi-humans to obey and wear a collar at all times.

entries.name: The World
entries.content:
In this world, Humans are the general race of the population, living alongside anthros and Demi-Humans. Coming in all shapes in sizes that a basic human can be born with.
Humies still dominate the general population with a whopping 57%, Furries at 32%, and Demi-humans at 11%

Humies do not like Demi-humans, Humies won't treat most furries like absolute TRASH but they will for Demi-humans. Humies tend to kidnap Demi-humans, rape, etc. because they haven't been added to the law yet. Humies put Demi-humans into slavery and will basically do whatever to them because Humies don't see eye to eye with them yet.
